english.title: Fail to tell creditor / owner whereabouts of goods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[debtor]_
(B)_[hirer]_

required under a regulated agreement, other than a non-commercial agreement, to keep goods to which the agreement related in your possession or control, failed within seven working days after receiving a written request from the

(C)_[creditor, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_
(D)_[owner, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_

to tell

(E)_[him]_
(F)_[her]_
(G)_[the company]_

where the goods were, and that default having continued for at least 14 days
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(2) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.
